actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two attacks: one with its [[/item .WqD5jsrWCeNHoD9O]]{claws} and one with its [[/item .ywVQhULZvd4Jn51c]]{club}.

actions.name: luring song
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} sings a magical melody. Every humanoid and giant within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=SStRaAbx3AgLlBAU]] feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that can hear the song must succeed on a [[/save activity=SStRaAbx3AgLlBAU]] saving throw or be &reference[charmed] until the song ends. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is &reference[incapacitated apply=false]. While charmed by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, a target is &reference[incapacitated] and ignores the songs of other harpies. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet away from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, the target must move on its turn toward the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn't avoid &reference[opportunity attacks], but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, the target can repeat the saving throw. A charmed target can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it. A target that successfully saves is immune to this [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s song for the next 24 hours.
